newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Georgian trade official murdered in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Georgian trade official murdered in Moscow.

text.p: A Georgian trade official was murdered in a courtyard off Moscow's central Ring Road in broad daylight on Friday evening, police said.

Police said they found the bodies of Befik Devdariani, deputy head of the Georgian Embassy's commercial representation, and a former Georgian commercial adviser ,Nikolas Nishneonidze, after about 6 p.m. on Friday.
They said they did not know the motive for the killings but had started an investigation.
